review:
A classic fruit slot with a bonus that spreads across six grids. Three ice cubes on reels 1, 3 and 5 start a pre-bonus round that randomly sets up your free spins.

You can tweak that pre-bonus with feature bets and a Respin All button, just like Hottest 666, then play the bonus with Wild Rain over several grids. Very high volatility, a 6,600x max and 96% RTP. Free spins about once every 150 spins. The frosty sibling of Hottest 666.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 150 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
